decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already records the Mint #1 ticket exception and the resulting one-ticket-per-primary-mint-after-Mint-#1 reconciliation rule.
The one-off absence of a first-mint ticket and commission does not change the candidate's metadata identity, attribute-visibility, or historical-backfill requirements.
The first-mint reward exception does not alter which successfully minted NFTs must appear in the dashboard inventory.
The source decision concerns first-mint ticket and commission accounting, not the display of referral counts.
The accepted first-mint reward exception does not change how recorded referral activity must be represented in public referral statistics.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records that one Small Block ticket is generated for each primary mint after Mint #1 and that Mint #1 is an exception.
Ticket and commission reconciliation has no effect on NFT image sizing or wallet and dashboard media rendering.
The client accepted the already-occurring Mint #1 case as a one-off with no forward impact, so the FAQ's prospective no-referral explanation remains valid unchanged.
The first-mint ticket and commission exception does not alter the label or sales-based measure of the next-prize-draw countdown.
Mint #1 remains a successfully completed mint; only its ticket and commission awards are excepted, so the public mint-counting basis is unchanged.
The source decision changes referral-ticket and commission totals but does not change the prize-pool contribution or its displayed accounting.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records that no commission is awarded for Mint #1 when no existing NFT holder is available, followed by the appropriate RESUME.
